title: sphaerostephanos loherianus
intro: Sphaerostephanos loherianus, commonly known as Loher's fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryniaceae. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Loher's fern include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of fever and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
